cat > rosterkit/contacts.py <<'EOF'
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def contact_rows(students):
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda s: s.display_name)
    name_width = max(len(s.display_name) for s in ordered)
    section_width = max(len(s.section) for s in ordered)
    result = [
        f"{s.display_name:<{name_width}}  "
        f"{s.section:<{section_width}}  {s.email}"
        for s in ordered
    ]
    return result
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


def make(last, first, section, email):
    return Student("1", last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            make("Young", "Al", "B", "al@x.org"),
            make("Abbott", "Bea", "A", "bea@x.org"),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Abbott, Bea  A  bea@x.org",
            "Young, Al    B  al@x.org",
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Young, Al"):
            contact_rows([make("Young", "Al", "B", None)])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
